description: FireUn — the ember unicorn. 8,888 lottery-ticket NFTs on Base. Free mint + 0.0001 ETH fee per mint. Every mint splits 88.88% to the deployer and 11.12% to the prize pool. 88 winning tickets: 8 GOLDEN and 80 EMBER. Winning token IDs were committed by hash before mint opened, so the draw is provably fair. Winners claim their share from their ticket's own vault. No seed — the prize grows from fees only.
name: FireUn
